tool.name: Get Runtime Catalog
tool.description: Inspect current provider/model runtime availability for agent self-configuration.

provider.description: Optional provider ID filter, e.g. anthropic, openai, localMLX.

usable_only.description: Only include providers and models that are usable now.

include_models.description: Include model rows under each provider.

ai.systemPromptSection:
### get_runtime_catalog
Inspect the current ProviderKit-backed runtime catalog before calling agent_state_configure_runtime with provider/model IDs.

**Format:**
```tool_request
{"tool":"get_runtime_catalog","query":"{\"provider\":\"anthropic\",\"usable_only\":true}"}
```

**Returns:** Provider/model IDs, key/device/download availability, unavailable reasons, and usableNow status.
whenToUse: Before selecting provider/model IDs for agent_state_configure_runtime
When a runtime target fails because it is unavailable
When checking whether local, key-backed, or downloaded models are usable now
whenNotToUse: To learn a tool's call grammar; use get_tool_details instead
To change runtime state; use agent_state_configure_runtime instead
